items.source: Defines whether to off-load intensive sort-operations to disk.
items.translation: 定义是否将耗时的排序操作卸载到磁盘。

items.source: Define a hint that is used by query optimizer to to fulfill the aggregation.
items.translation: 定义一个由查询优化器用于执行聚合操作的提示。

items.source: Obtain a new AggregationOptions.Builder for constructing AggregationOptions.
items.translation: 获取一个新的AggregationOptions.Builder，用于构建AggregationOptions。

items.source: Returns a new AggregationOptions.Builder.
items.translation: 返回一个新的AggregationOptions.Builder。

items.source: Apply a relaxed domain type mapping considering Field annotations using the user provided name if a referenced field does not exist.
items.translation: 应用一种宽松的域类型映射，对于引用的字段不存在的情况，使用用户提供的名称，并考虑 Field 注解。

items.source: Apply a strict domain type mapping considering Field annotations throwing errors for non-existent, but referenced fields.
items.translation: 应用严格的领域类型映射，针对存在错误（即引用了不存在的字段）的Field注解进行处理。

items.source: Define a ReadConcern to apply to the aggregation.
items.translation: 定义一个应用于聚合操作的ReadConcern。

items.source: Define a ReadPreference to apply to the aggregation.
items.translation: 定义一个应用于聚合的ReadPreference。

items.source: Support for the MongoDB aggregation framework.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 聚合框架。

items.source: Define collation settings for string comparison.
items.translation: 定义字符串比较的排序规则设置。

items.source: Define a comment to describe the execution.
items.translation: 定义一个注释以描述执行过程。

items.source: Define the initial cursor batch size.
Defines whether to get the execution plan for the aggregation instead of the actual results.
items.translation: 定义是否获取聚合的执行计划而非实际结果。

items.source: Set the time limit for processing.
Apply no domain type mapping at all taking the pipeline as-is.
items.translation: 完全不应用任何域类型映射，直接采用原始管道。

items.source: Run the aggregation, but do NOT read the aggregation result from the store.
items.translation: 执行聚合，但请勿从存储中读取聚合结果。

items.source: Uses of AggregationOptions.Builder in org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation
items.translation: AggregationOptions.Builder 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.aggregation 中的用途
